title: Brownie Time!
description: In the kitchen, kid-3 asks Grandma if they can make brownies. Grandma enthusiastically agrees and reaches for the mixing bowl.
alt: In a cozy kitchen, Grandma Kelly wears an apron labeled “Grandma Kelly” and reaches for a mixing bowl while smiling at kid-3, who is excitedly holding a wooden spoon beside her. Kid-3 asks, “Grandma, can we make brownies?” Grandma replies, “Absolutely!”
